CAMERA.NAME: Cameras
CAMERA.DESCRIPTION: IP cameras (RTSP / ONVIF) with live view in the visualization via go2rtc

GO2RTC_URL.NAME: go2rtc URL
GO2RTC_URL.DESCRIPTION: Address of the go2rtc API. The server starts its own go2rtc on http://127.0.0.1:1984 when it is installed; use the address of your go2rtc container otherwise

GO2RTC_USERNAME.NAME: go2rtc user
GO2RTC_USERNAME.DESCRIPTION: User of the go2rtc API, empty if it has no authentication

POLL.NAME: Polling interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: How often the online state is checked and missing streams are registered in go2rtc again

SCAN.NAME: Find ONVIF cameras
SCAN.DESCRIPTION: Searches the local network for ONVIF cameras

HOST.NAME: Host
HOST.DESCRIPTION: IP address or host name of the camera

ONVIF_PORT.NAME: ONVIF port
ONVIF_PORT.DESCRIPTION: HTTP port of the ONVIF service (usually 80, some cameras use 8000, 8080 or 2020)

USERNAME.NAME: User
USERNAME.DESCRIPTION: User of the camera, used for ONVIF and the streams

USE_ONVIF.NAME: Use ONVIF
USE_ONVIF.DESCRIPTION: Reads the stream and snapshot URLs that are not set from the camera, and the motion events

STREAM_MAIN.NAME: Main stream
STREAM_MAIN.DESCRIPTION: RTSP URL of the high resolution stream (fullscreen view), e.g. rtsp://192.168.1.20:554/stream1. Empty = from ONVIF. The user and password are added when the URL has none

STREAM_SUB.NAME: Sub stream
STREAM_SUB.DESCRIPTION: RTSP URL of the low resolution stream (tiles). Empty = from ONVIF, or the main stream

SNAPSHOT_URL.NAME: Snapshot URL
SNAPSHOT_URL.DESCRIPTION: HTTP URL of a JPEG snapshot, used for the still image mode. Empty = from ONVIF

EVENTS.NAME: Motion events
EVENTS.DESCRIPTION: Follows the ONVIF events of the camera (motion, person detection)

ONLINE.NAME: Online
ONLINE.DESCRIPTION: True while the camera accepts connections

MOTION.NAME: Motion
MOTION.DESCRIPTION: True while the camera reports motion

PERSON.NAME: Person
PERSON.DESCRIPTION: True while the camera reports a person (if the camera detects persons)
